sections.title: What problem this solves
sections.text: Stripped namespaces and assembly-qualified tokens show up in stack traces. [`Lyo.PackageMetadata`](../Lyo.PackageMetadata/README.md) resolves which NuGet or Git package owns a prefix for diagnostics overlays. `PostgresPackageMetadataStore` implements the store against normalized tables (`PackageStackPrefix` rows ordered by `NormalizedPrefix` length) so resolution is `O(sorted prefixes)` in-process after each DB read. The bulk API loads all prefixes once per call when caching allows.

sections.title: How storage is modeled (conceptual)
items: `PackageMetadataEntity` holds catalog metadata (id, package name, version range, SPDX/license expression blobs). See EF configurations for the rest.
`PackageStackPrefixEntity` maps `NormalizedPrefix` to the owning package. Longest prefix wins.

sections.title: Bulk resolution (`TryGetManyForStrippedMethodPrefixesAsync`)
items: Input: distinct stripped prefixes (typically one per decoded stack frame subtree).
Output: a dictionary with one entry per input key; the value is `null` when nothing matches contract rules.
Requested keys are never dropped silently. That invariant keeps `Lyo.Diagnostic` bulk decode paths deterministic.

sections.title: Caching the prefix catalog (`PostgresPrefixCatalogCachingMode`)
rows: Keep an immutable in-process snapshot. Reload when mutations bump the generation counter (`RegisterManyAsync` or `ClearPrefixCatalogCache` on the same instance).
Always hit Postgres. Wrap with an outer cache yourself if importing huge catalogs asynchronously.
sections.lead: Repeated DB chatter is gated by `PostgresPackageMetadataOptions.PrefixCatalogCaching`:
sections.trail:
When caching is disabled, `ClearPrefixCatalogCache()` is a no-op on the cache. It only bumps the generation.

Cross-process writes do not invalidate. Disable the snapshot or bust the cache after CLI imports.

sections.title: DI registration (`Extensions`)
items: **AddPackageMetadataDbContextFactory** (and `FromConfiguration`). Binds `PostgresPackageMetadataOptions`, registers the `PackageMetadataDbContext` factory, attaches `AddPostgresMigrations` bootstrap.
**AddPostgresPackageMetadataStore.** Factory plus `IPackageMetadataStore` as `PostgresPackageMetadataStore` singleton resolving options and `IDbContextFactory`.

sections.title: Schema and migrations
sections.text: Migrations live under `Migrations/`. Table names and schema follow `PostgresPackageMetadataOptions.Schema`. Inspect the snapshot for authoritative DDL.

sections.title: Related reading
items: Stack decode and breadcrumb tooling that optionally consumes `IPackageMetadataStore`: [`Lyo.Diagnostic`](../../Diagnostic/Lyo.Diagnostic/README.md).
